<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the dominant isotopic pattern is a pair of peaks at m/z ≈199 and ≈201 with nearly equal intensities, which is characteristic of a single bromine atom (⁷⁹Br/⁸¹Br ≈1:1). No other element shows a definitive isotopic signature in this data. Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified is bromine.</thought>
<final_answer>['Br']</final_answer>
